data.one_liner: Displays DOCX files across Flutter platforms
data.what_it_does: The package provides a widget that extracts and renders the text content of DOCX files. It supports network URLs, local file paths, and raw bytes, with error handling callbacks.
use_when: Need to display DOCX documents in a Flutter app
Want a single widget that works on mobile, desktop, and web
Need to load documents from a URL or a file picker
avoid_when: You only need to display PDFs or other document types
You require rich formatting or styling beyond plain text
strengths: Cross‑platform support (Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, Linux)
Simple API: just provide filePath or bytes
Web‑friendly: works with file picker and bytes
weaknesses: Only extracts plain text, no formatting or images
Requires file_picker for local files on web
No support for editing or advanced document features
data.setup_notes: Add `docx_viewer` to pubspec.yaml. For web local files, add `file_picker` dependency and use bytes. No special permissions needed.
